name: 27410 · Greensboro, NC
findings: ZIP 27410 (Greensboro) has 242 nonprofit organizations. 93 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27410 (Greensboro) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 15 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
